Professional Experience:

Experienced professional in the investment banking and fund accounting sector with expertise in trade settlement, reconciliation, and fund accounting. Organization: Inter Continental Exchange

August :2023- Present

Designation: - Trade Operations Analyst-II Process: -

Trade Settlement

Roles and Responsibilities: -

➢ Monitored real time trade flow in system, ensuring trades are accurately captured, validated, and

ready for clearing settlement

➢ Identify, investigate, and resolve trade breaks and exceptions in real time by directly liaising with

traders, clearing members, and settlement desks.

➢ Drive trade settlement coordination, ensuring smooth handover between front and back office while

meeting tight market deadlines.

➢ I resolve trade breaks in system and exception to meet T+1 settlement deadlines while minimizing

regulatory risk and Buy-in

➢ Managed client escalation on trade status and settlement ensuring SLA adherence. ➢ Performing root cause analysis on trade mismatched to reduce fails and improve settlement. ➢ Need to regular communicate with brokers and counterparties on settlement status and fails

resolution.

➢ I coordinate with risk, legal and compliance to close fails with in T+3 and regulatory timelines. ➢ Produce and present regulatory and market activity reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) to senior

management, ensuring compliance with exchange rules. Liaise with clients, traders, senior leaders, and support staff to facilitate trade confirmations and problem resolution.

Process: Fund Accouting

➢ Performing end to end fund valuation and striking of daily and weekly Nav’s

fund accountant.

➢ Complete reconciliation for the NAV related cash Break

➢ Preparing and delivering of monthly, Quarterly, Half yearly and Annual audit reports to the client.
